hotspots.title: Polish Constitutional Court Crisis & Coup Accusations
hotspots.blurb: Tension in Poland has reached a breaking point as President Karol Nawrocki forcefully entered the Constitutional Tribunal amid an escalating standoff with Donald Tusk's government. Protesters, police clashes, and mutual allegations of unconstitutional power grabs have turned the legal struggle into a national crisis. Marine Le Pen and European observers have weighed in, highlighting growing fears of deep political instability.
hotspots.affect: The physical confrontation at the Constitutional Tribunal and charges of authoritarian overreach have sparked maximum outrage and ideological polarization across European coverage.

hotspots.title: Flávio Bolsonaro Defeat & Brazil Election Fraud Claims
hotspots.blurb: Following his election loss to Lula da Silva, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro fled Brazil for Florida in a covert operation allegedly aided by a former Mossad agent and Trump allies. The escape, violating travel bans and sparking legal efforts to freeze his salary, has thrown the Bolsonarista movement into disarray while straining US-Brazil diplomatic relations. Donald Trump's public offer allowing Flávio to remain in the US has further intensified international scrutiny.
hotspots.affect: The dramatic illegal flight, secret agent allegations, and high-stakes asylum offer by Donald Trump generate maximum affective investment and anger across Latin American and global media.

hotspots.title: Urda Train Disaster & Spanish Right Poll Surge
hotspots.blurb: Following a deadly railway derailment in Urda, Santiago Abascal's Vox and the PP have launched fierce attacks against Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez and Transport Minister Óscar Puente while joining legal proceedings. New polling shows the tragedy has triggered a massive collapse in PSOE support, pushing the right-wing bloc to a historical record that would hand PP and Vox an absolute majority. Left-wing figures and commentators have slammed Vox for exploiting the tragedy in a spiral of political hostility.
hotspots.affect: The combination of a mass-casualty disaster, aggressive political exploitation, and dramatic polling shifts creates an intense, morally charged confrontation dominating Spanish media.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen Launches RN Campaign & Congress
hotspots.blurb: Marine Le Pen launched her 2027 presidential campaign in Orléans while taking prominent international stances, including strong condemnation of Donald Tusk's actions in Poland. Polling reveals up to 19% of Emmanuel Macron's former voters are now leaning toward Le Pen amid ongoing fiscal and security anxieties in France. However, pending legal rulings on her eligibility and internal party friction with Marion Maréchal keep high stakes surrounding her political future.
hotspots.affect: Le Pen's early campaign blitz, expanding voter coalition, and looming judicial eligibility deadline create a high-stakes arena of intense partisan momentum and legal jeopardy.

hotspots.title: Nigel Farage MP Altercation Row & Reform Campaign
hotspots.blurb: Reform UK faces escalating scrutiny after the Equalities and Human Rights Commission (EHRC) launched an inquiry into widespread racist and misogynistic comments made by party representatives in an ITV exposé. Multiple council resignations and revelations about Farage's security detail have forced the party on the defensive. Farage has sought to regain campaign momentum by pledging distinctively British military reforms, including reviving the Territorial Army name.
hotspots.affect: Public exposures of racism, regulatory intervention by the EHRC, and defensive media skirmishes keep Reform UK under heavy, emotionally charged media focus.
